name: SKYLANDX
name_zh: 深圳市无穹创新科技有限公司
summary:
SKYLANDX is an intelligent hardware company focused on spatial intelligence, covering the complete chain from spatial perception and localization/mapping to intelligent control. Since its founding in 2020, it has concentrated on three core technologies: robot localization, perception and path planning. It has independently developed intelligent hardware and solutions including 3D spatial scanners, indoor inspection drones and intelligent inspection robots.
The company was the first team incubated at HKCRC (Hong Kong Center for Construction Robotics), founded by Professor Li Zexiang. Drawing on industry, academic and research resources, it follows real-world needs and technological innovation to explore connections between people and spaces, and machines and the world. By combining leading robotics technologies with 3D scene-reconstruction algorithms, it aims to build spatial intelligence solutions across environments and support spatial digitization in embodied intelligence, construction and real estate, industrial inspection and digital entertainment.
